name: Line chart
purpose: Trend over time as straight-segment polylines, single- or multi-series — the round-one dataviz kit's line family graduated into canon, LAYER-2 RESTORED (chart-revisit exemplar 2026-07-23: Dave ruled the proforma's interaction layer IS the bar). Semantic SVG styled by tokens, decorative motion by CSS, behaviour by the ADR-0015 generated JS partial (dv-behaviour), described by a real table. PROVISIONAL-AGENT: promoted from the PARKED kit (9 review rounds, not signed off); geometry, easing and marker cadence are OBSERVED kit values.

props.name: series
props.$note: 1–5; each series carries colour (data/series/N) + MARKER SHAPE (dv-line-002: circle r4.2 · square 8.4 · diamond ±4.9) + letter key A/B/C repeated in the legend (§04.3) — colour is never the only channel (dv-011).

props.name: data
props.$note: Real <table class="dv-table"> in the figure (dv-005), surfaced by the table-view popover panel; popover data-tips read the SAME values (one source).

props.name: markers
props.$note: Promoted default = BACKGROUND mode (series-colour fill + page stroke at line width 2.5 — theme-adaptive, no absolute white on dark). The kit's White/Background comparison toggle is UNRESOLVED — receipted for Dave; flipping is a CSS pair swap.

props.name: empty
props.$note: No-data state = the Empty-state pattern by reference.

props.name: title
props.$note: OPTIONAL visible title slot (.dv-title, dv-006: reflects the main insight) — a type composite heading (t-cm-section-label); when absent the sr-only figcaption still names the chart.

props.name: tablePopover
props.$note: Table-view POPOVER panel (Dave's mock 2026-07-23): floating card on surface ground + elevation border/shadow recipe, 'View as table' ⇄ 'Hide table' toggle top-right; aria-controls/expanded, labelled region, Esc-dismiss, focus-managed. Supersedes the native <details>.

props.name: legendFilter
props.$note: Multi-series legend rows are FILTER buttons (data-series-toggle, aria-pressed; off = dim + line-through — never colour alone). QUIET utility state, deliberately NOT B-D7 press physics (chart-revisit Q5, standing).

props.name: highContrast
props.$note: data-contrast="high" remaps series onto data/series-high-contrast/* (token rebind only, kit pattern).

variants.name: single series
variants.use: One measure over time; markers on every point, month labels along x.

variants.name: multi-series
variants.use: 2–5 measures; shapes + letters + legend names carry identity alongside colour.

variants.name: no data
variants.use: Empty-state pattern in the chart frame.

motion.entry: Lines draw via stroke-dasharray with pathLength=2400 (Batch 9 — the dash spans the full 2400ms timeline, rescale-immune), 2400ms cubic-bezier(.33,0,.3,1) (Batch 6); all series draw SIMULTANEOUSLY (Batch 4); markers land on the Batch-8 EASED cadence (delays follow the line's easing — 0·369·507·…·2400ms), each as the drawing head passes it.
motion.hover: Interactive value POPOVER (dvTip — behaviour partial): pointer + keyboard focus, edge-flips, role=status; replaces native <title>. Values == table.
motion.reducedMotion: Draw + fade sit inside prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference; global collapse also present.

responsive.rule: DV-D02 + fit RESTORED (behaviour partial): baked-fraction relayout (data-fx/-fxs/-ys/-fx2/-x0; frame data-pl/-pr/-h 46/12/260) to the container width on a single rAF-debounced resize — fixed height, TEXT NEVER SCALES (viewBox pinned 1:1). JS-off falls back to the static answer: fixed 580×260 + horizontal scroll.

mustNotNeighbour: A second chart re-using these series colours for DIFFERENT data in the same journey (dv-014)

accessibility.role: figure role="group" + aria-labelledby → sr-only figcaption; svg role="group" + aria-label (interactive children — role img would hide the marker focus stops); table panel role="region".
accessibility.name: Figcaption names the chart; markers carry aria-label == data-tip == table values; the real table is the full data surface.
accessibility.keyboard: Markers = focus stops (tabindex 0 + aria-label; popover shows on focus). Legend filter buttons + table toggle keyboard-operable; panel takes focus on open (tabindex -1), Esc returns to toggle.
accessibility.nonText: Series strokes ≥3:1 vs the page both modes (dv-016); series identity = shape + letter + name, never colour alone (dv-line-002 / §04.3 / 1.4.1).

antiPatterns: Curved/smoothed series paths (dv-line-011 — straight segments only)
Colour as the only series identity (shapes + letters + names, always)
White-fill markers hardcoded on dark (halation; the promoted default is series fill + page stroke)
A fixed stroke-dasharray without pathLength (the Batch-9 root cause — line finishes early, nodes trail)
Scaling the SVG proportionally at narrow widths (DV-D02 — text must never scale)
A chart without its real data table (dv-005)
Re-typing dv-behaviour locally (ADR-0015 — consume the AUTO-BEHAVIOUR partial)
B-D7 press physics on legend/toolbar pressables (quiet utility state — Q5 posture)
